verdict.rationale: mise provides task automation (tasks, dependency graphs, `mise watch` for file-triggered reruns) and an MCP server that lets an AI assistant invoke mise tasks, which are building blocks for automation, but there is no evidence of a persistent background daemon, scheduler/cron, or fully autonomous unattended execution mode — `mise watch` requires an active foreground session and MCP-driven task runs are agent-invoked rather than self-scheduling. missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/cron-like autonomous triggers, a background daemon/service mode, and confirmation that AI agents can set up truly unattended recurring automations without a live session.
